role: selected-panel fold-local method-development diagnostic; not representative or final test
outer_training: frozen per-fold allowlists from FOLD_SELECTION.json; each evaluation query uses its source OOF fold
inner_validation: subject-stratified 20% within the fold-local development allowlist
gate: class-balanced any-alternative-beats-R1 logistic; fixed threshold grid selected on inner validation; residual Ridge alternative selector
limits: Opportunity-enriched development panel; no population-level MMLU claim.
Five repeats add label precision but not independent query count.
A newly frozen representative panel is required after method selection.
